title: phaseolus linearis var. coriaceus
intro: Phaseolus linearis var. coriaceus, commonly known as wild kidney bean, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular diseases, as well as its potential to aid in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus linearis var. coriaceus are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
